title: Avila Core Named Reference v0.1 draft
description: A name's binding to an exact revision (and assessment, when the name claims a result) within one campaign log (ADR-0019). Moving a name appends a new record that cites the target it superseded; prior moves are never rewritten. A claim about significance, never a verdict input.

superseded_revision_id.description: The target this name pointed at before this record, resolved under the append lock. Absent on a name's first binding.

rationale.description: The mover's stated reason; inert text, never instructions.
